overview: The story of two close friends, with bitterness hidden in every promise... yet a sweetness remains that makes the heart tremble with every memory.
title: Bites of Promise

overview: In 1989, a rookie editor visits a mysterious mansion for a séance, only for a psychic to vanish and a string of murders to begin. As a young mystery writer joins the investigation, dark secrets hidden in a cryptic poem left by the mansion's owner start to unravel.
title: Tokeikan no Satsujin

overview: The Witches Of Cambridge follows two brilliant young women in 1950s Cambridge, Massachusetts, as they become immersed in a mysterious secret group of witches at Radcliffe known as the Lilith Society.
title: The Witches Of Cambridge
How A Peacock Burns Its Feathers

overview: Jane Patrick is a mysterious young man with a dangerously captivating charm who can make any wish come true, as long as you agree to a non-negotiable exchange. Because of that, no one dares get close to him. But Jane Jennalee, a handsome young football player, boldly approaches Jane Patrick to ask for his ball back without the slightest fear. That moment becomes the starting point of their connection. Friends constantly warn Jane Jennalee that Jane Patrick is dangerous, and he must never ask him for anything. However, Jane Jennalee feels that this man is actually gentle and kind. As their relationship deepens, Jennalee begins to see another side of him, leaving him unable to stop wondering who Jane Patrick truly is.
title: Don't Be Too Emotional

overview: Campus Ladies, a loosely scripted comedy series that proves you are never too old to party like a freshman. Joan and Barry are middle-aged best friends who've decided it's better to be freshmen at 40 than unhappy housewives forever, so they ditch their suburban lives of minivans and malls for keg stands and co-ed dorms. While their classmates think they are closer to breaking a hip than being hip, they're old enough to know that youth is a wonderful thing so why should it be wasted on the young? Campus Ladies is a single-camera comedy series.
title: Campus Ladies

overview: Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt. Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.
title: История его служанки

overview: Homebodies follows Darcy a trans man who reluctantly returns to his regional hometown to care for his estranged mother Nora. But home isn't as he left it. Nora has been living with a secret housemate: Dee, the teenage ghost of Darcy's pre-transition self. As old wounds resurface, Darcy must confront the parts of himself he tried to leave behind or risk losing himself entirely.
title: Homebodies
Talons aiguilles et bottes de paille

overview: After giving birth, a highly accomplished professional finds herself overwhelmed by the realities of motherhood. Hoping to gain more care and understanding from her family, she pretends to have postpartum depression—but the lie backfires when two generations begin living together, throwing her life into chaos as she struggles to balance her career, relationships, and sense of self.
title: The Adorable Family

overview: A law school student and her friends, set out to prove her brother's innocence but the only way to clear his name is by finding the real killer.
title: True Justice

overview: How did the artists start their journey, what difficulties did they have to face, how did they overcome them, and what legacy did they leave? Why was Shura looked at as an alien? Why did the "Ranetki" banish the main participant? What kind of diagnosis almost put an end to Shura's career? And what did the producer of "Ranetok" do to save the drowning band? All this and more is in the "Put on a ringtone" project.
title: Поставь на рингтон

overview: Travel guide to the regions of Russia with the stars of Russian sports. The documentary project will show the unique places of the country and tell the stories of becoming champions. The film crew travels to different parts of Russia from North Ossetia to Kamchatka to show where the champions grew up. In four episodes, the program will tell about how St. Petersburg became the capital of basketball, what the childhood of the strongest wrestler was like, how the harsh climate brought up the famous skier and why North Ossetia is called "little Brazil".
title: Где рождаются чемпионы

overview: Human interest series in which Philippe Geubels works as a fear coach and helps Flemish people overcome their fears.
title: Gene paniek

overview: On average, a woman is murdered in our country every two weeks. Phara de Aguirre and Nahid Shaikh speak with relatives and victims of femicide.
title: En Nu Is Ze Dood

overview: JJ Ramburg hosts MSNBC's weekly small business program featuring profiles of small business owners, business headlines, and the 'Small Biz Top Five'.
title: Your Business

overview: Two monks confront perimenopause — and uncover the global health crisis every woman needs to know about.
title: Balance: A Perimenopause Journey

overview: In a desperate attempt to revitalize his stagnant career, prosecutor Bang Tae Seop hatches an absurd but daring plan: take down the mayor of Seoul by exposing her corrupt ties to Lee Yang Mi, the head of the WR Group conglomerate. Tae Seop recruits Hwang Jeong Won to serve as an informant and manages to convince Kwon Jong Uk, a WR Group heir with his own grudge against Yang Mi, to join his cause. However, Tae Seop soon finds himself in a more complicated situation than he initially expected when he discovers that his wife Chu Sang Ah, a formerly loved actress, may be hiding dangerous secrets from him.
title: Climax

overview: Akihiro Kaji, a popular "ace" from the sales department at his company, is seen as admirable by his co-workers, but he is secretly a narcissistic playboy who looks down on others, giving them scores based on their attractiveness. One day, Kaji is paired with Yu Fukami on a business trip. Despite Kaji finding him sloppy and disshevled at first, he becomes drawn to after discovering he is sexually attractive.
title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami

overview: The protagonists of the story are Chinami Natsuno, Hikaru Baji, and Ayase Noda, who met through a university club. The trio, who spent their evenings drinking and playing board games, each harboured their own complicated romantic troubles. Now aged 27, Chinami and her friends begin to reconsider matters of romance, love, and marriage. After witnessing their friend Misaki flee a wedding ceremony they attended, they are compelled to confront their own romantic issues.
title: Shitsuren Karuta

overview: Kei is a virgin novelist with zero dating experience. And yet, his next work is BL!? Suddenly, Kei's devilish stepbrother, Kairi, appears before him. His seemingly experienced brother will teach him the thrills of romance, but...
title: My Stepbrother Is My Favorite Novelist!?

overview: "Mordufer" is set in the border triangle on the northern shore of Lake Constance and combines the investigative work of the criminal investigation department and customs. The story centers on two dissimilar women: Doro Beitinger, in her early 40s, returns to her job after several years of caring for her family, children, and sick mother. Her new boss at the police department, Chiara Locatelli, is in her late 20s, ambitious, and comes from an Italian family background. Two women from different generations, with different lifestyles, who quickly realize that they work perfectly together as a team and can even solve seemingly unsolvable cases. Due to the border location, the two regularly work with their colleagues from customs, represented by customs officer Florian Jäger and senior customs inspector Nico Arnold.
title: Mordufer

overview: Century Plant: We're Partners, Friends, and Sometimes Lovers (センプラ 相方が親友で時どき恋人) is a Japanese BL vertical drama. There are 30 short episodes in total. The story is adapted from a manga by Jiro Kawaii (河飯じろう).
title: Century Plant: We're Partners, Friends, and Sometimes Lovers

overview: The rise of a violent rogue state and the journalists who disappeared. Loyalty and coercion collide in Islamic State Group's chilling kidnap of James Foley and John Cantlie.
title: Hostage

overview: Detectives unite across states to capture serial killer Ted Bundy, unveiled via new crime scene photos and intense police interviews.
title: Hunting Bundy: Chase For The Devil

overview: Across millennia, snakes have captivated human imagination, feared as omens of danger yet revered as symbols of rebirth, transformation and renewal. Today, more than 4,000 species of these extraordinary reptiles share our planet, playing a vital role in maintaining ecological balance by controlling rodent populations. Equipped with remarkable sensory systems and some of the most potent venoms in nature, evolution has honed each snake into a masterful predator. From scorching deserts to lush rainforests, see how these creatures have adapted to thrive in every corner of the planet and uncover the hidden world of snakes.
title: The Hidden World of Snakes

overview: Girlfriends is a sophisticated comedy series that invites viewers into the lives of three professional African American women living in Los Angeles who are struggling with the weighty issues of life - men, love, money -- and more men. Girlfriends returns for its triumphant final year, providing an open, honest exploration of the hot-button issues about family, friends, relationships and life facing women today. With fearlessness and sincerity, the show takes on universal issues that interest all women. Whether it is being recently engaged, exploring your career or balancing friendships and a new baby, Girlfriends treats them all with tenderness, care and respect.
title: Girlfriends

overview: Hosted by Sri Jegarajah from the Singapore Exchange and Nancy Hulgrave in London, Capital Connection gives you a reading on Asia's markets mid-day and sets you up for the European trading day.
title: Capital Connection

overview: At the prestigious art institute Ars Viva, the new teacher Alejandro faces a classroom of rebellious girls, led by Paloma, who becomes his biggest challenge and secret love interest.
title: Besos robados

overview: In this film, authors, experts and those who have just experienced the processes of democratization will try to figure out together why good intentions often turn into abuse and chaos, whether universal values are so universal and how they combine or not with the national mentality of different peoples.
title: Демократизация народов

overview: A project that reveals the secrets of one of Van Gogh's main masterpieces, "Red Vineyards in Arles." The documentary series is dedicated to the work of studying and preserving the painting.
title: Тайна красных виноградников

overview: Top actress Momo is preparing to marry Ju Shin, the accomplished director of a neurosurgery hospital who seems to have everything. But a sudden accident leaves her body intact while her brain is fatally damaged, plunging her into a coma. Faced with the devastating possibility of losing the woman he loves, genius neurosurgeon Ju Shin makes a desperate decision and ventures into forbidden medical territory. In a final attempt to save her, he performs an unprecedented "brain change" surgery, transferring another soul into Momo's body. When she opens her eyes again, the soul within her is no longer the woman he once loved. If another soul inhabits the body of the person you love, can that love remain the same? A forbidden choice made to save love unfolds into an unforeseen fate and devastating consequences.
title: Doctor Shin

overview: Seong Tae Hun, a high-ranking executive, is suddenly reassigned to the rural village of Yeonri-ri with his family. Unprepared for country life, Cho Mi Ryeo struggles as farming and housework prove harder than expected. Meanwhile, their eldest son, Seong Ji Cheon, once bound for medical school, begins to discover himself. However, village chief Im Ju Hyeong grows wary of the family, who arrived with a major corporation. As they endure rural life while longing to return, can they find their way back?
title: Cabbage Your Life

overview: A broken former superhero, Bedaine tries to find meaning in his life in his hometown. Between wacky enemies, deep wounds, and lost wings, he will discover that there are other ways to be a hero.
title: Bedaine

overview: Bole UP is a flagship infotainment program produced by Doordarshan Kendra Lucknow for the DD Uttar Pradesh network. The show blends interviews with audience participation and cultural showcases, featuring spotlights from regional talents.
title: Bole UP

overview: Seven couples move out of their comfort zones and onto the therapist's couch to try and work through their relationship issues in this reality series.
title: Blue Therapy

overview: On Street Signs, CNBC's global headquarters provides market and business analysis live, as well as up-to-the-minute market transactions. Anchor Julianna Tatelbaum reads the signs on Wall Street, looking for under-the-radar stocks and market trends that can help viewers make wise investments.
title: Street Signs

overview: In this documentary, three friends recount their memories of a series of crimes that changed their lives and rocked their quiet corner of rural Denmark.
title: En ven, en morder

overview: Set in pre-WWII Poland, this drama series follows a woman's fight for justice for victims of sexual assault – and her own autonomy.
title: Piekło Kobiet

overview: A physics teacher sets out to make quality education accessible to all students through online learning. Based on a true story.
title: Hello Bachhon

overview: A missing woman's family discovers that one of the last people to see her was a peculiar content creator — who was convicted of homicide years ago.
title: El Asesino de TikTok

overview: Crazy drivers kill innocent people on Danish roads every year. To combat life-threatening behavior in traffic, the police have been given a new tool: the insanity clause. With it in hand, the police now have the opportunity to punish Denmark's most dangerous drivers much more severely than before. Unconditional revocation of the driver's license, confiscation of the vehicle and imprisonment await road users who commit the worst offences.
title: Vanvidsbilisterne

overview: Series exploring the rich connections between Northern Ireland & the various countries in the world were Northern Irish people emigrated in large numbers to. Season 1 focused on New Zealand, Season 2 on Canada, Season 3 on the USA and Season 4 on Australia.
title: Brave New World

overview: We follow the professional rescuers from Viking roadside assistance – the previously overlooked heroes who head out when accidents and mishaps occur in traffic.
title: Vejens Helte

overview: The mysterious murder of a German tourist in the Peruvian Andes in 1997 sparks one of the most difficult and extensive investigations in German criminal history. As a tenacious seeker of the truth, Munich detective Nina Gummich embarks on a grueling mission that takes her across three continents and to her personal limits over the course of years. Based on a story by Rolf Basedow, the screenplay for this four-part crime series was written by Mika Kallwass and Nina Wolfrum.
title: Mord auf dem Inka-Pfad

overview: Britain's Almost Perfect Murders follows expert-led, forensic investigations of cases where meticulous, near-flawless crimes were ultimately uncovered due to tiny, overlooked fatal mistakes by the perpetrators.
title: Britain's Almost Perfect Murders

overview: Beyond the Brush takes viewers on a journey through the ages of art, exploring the evolution of creativity across centuries. Each episode uncovers hidden secrets, personal struggles, and the cultural shifts that shaped history's greatest masterpieces. From the brushstrokes of genius to the untold stories behind the canvas, this series will reveal how every work of art holds far more than meets the eye.
title: Beyond the Brush

overview: Set within the fictional realms of Charles Dickens' critically acclaimed novels, Dickensian brings together some of his most iconic characters, including Scrooge, Fagin and Miss Havisham, as their lives intertwine in 19th century London. The Old Curiosity Shop sits next door to The Three Cripples Pub, while Fagin's Den is hidden down a murky alley off a bustling Victorian street. With a wealth of back stories sourced from the novels, Dickensian delivers fast-paced storylines with surprising twists and turns in this 20-part series.
title: Dickensian

overview: When heirs of two feuding families become one another's first love, will it end in love or tragedy?
title: Juliet & Juliet

overview: You're Only Young Twice centers on Emily and Alex, who got pregnant and married in high school but now they're 35 and their kid is starting college. That means they can get divorced and start life all over again while they're still young enough to enjoy it. Newly divorced empty-nesters, they stumble through dating, co-parenting, and maybe a second chance at love.
title: You're Only Young Twice

overview: When a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy as a family of law enforcement agents become the target of a mysterious assassin. Bridging personal differences and crossing professional boundaries, the Hollingsworth family must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice... even if it means betraying their sworn code.
title: Line of Fire

overview: In Rivals, a series exclusive to Kayo Sports, some of the best rugby league players in the world will go head-to-head with their counterparts from Aussie Rules and Rugby Union to decide which code deserves bragging rights.
title: Rivals

overview: It seems that there is no place for failures in the life of cardiac surgeon Viktor Sturm, but the ideal facade is cracking due to problems in his personal life: Victoria's 14-year-old daughter loses trust in her father when he refuses to take on a hopeless patient. Trying to return his daughter's love, Sturm loses control, disrupts the operation and finds himself outside the profession. Trying to cope with a turning point in his career, a world-class doctor unexpectedly finds himself in a hospice, where his first wife and former classmate are dying. Trying to help her, Sturm gets a job at an institution as an orderly and, under the supervision of a local doctor, Maria Pichugina, nicknamed Birdie, begins the journey from a cynic to a man who is not afraid of death.
title: Хоспис

overview: Having received a tip on a rich house, Senya, who trades in small-scale criminal earnings, goes on a robbery. But he is caught by the owner, a very influential and eccentric businessman, Orlov, who also turns out to be blind. Suddenly, he doesn't turn him in to the police, but makes him his personal assistant. But the seemingly carefree life of a billionaire turns into a tough business struggle for Senya with a high-ranking official, where not only their own destinies, but also the lives of their loved ones are at stake.
title: Слепой

overview: Aktan and Lal, at an unexpected point in their lives, encounter a love they cannot control, and despite all their differences, they cannot resist each other.
title: Bize Bi'şey Olmaz

overview: Squawk on the Street is headquartered live on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange. We are there when the all-important opening bell rings every day. With our exclusive "Eye on the Floor" wireless cameras at the NYSE we take the viewer onto the floor of the exchange, right to the posts where the biggest companies in the world trade. In addition, our exclusive "Tick by Tick" charts track the action of every trade of every stock. Our live market coverage doesn't stop on the corner of Wall and Broad Streets in lower Manhattan. We also have exclusive coverage from the floor of the CME Group in Chicago giving our viewers the treasury, currency and commodity action in real time. In addition, "Squawk on the Street" is also on the air when the closing bells ring throughout Europe. That final hour of European trading starting at 10:30am eastern has proven to be very volatile and has a major impact on all U.S. based markets.
title: Squawk on the Street

overview: When an architecture student in his final year accidentally becomes a famous university fortune teller, he pretend-reveals that he was the childhood ship partner of the young heir to a real estate fortune. Although their relationship begins with a lie, it develops into a genuine love. At the same time, a young man fresh off a failed attempt to become a star in Korea comes back in search of his once-ship partner—who happens to be a particular real estate heir.
title: Magic Move

overview: On the run-up to the new millennium, CBBC launches its biggest ever game show. Hosted by heptathlete Denise Lewis, with Steve Wilson and Rachael Hopper.
title: 2 for 2000

overview: Short chibi specials streamed alongside with the Madan no Ou to Vanadis anime TV series. Each episode was available on the official web site, and were later included on DVD/Blu-ray release.
title: Tigre-kun to Vanadi-chu

overview: Born to Bowl takes viewers inside the colorful world of professional bowling, chronicling five stars of the sport – Kyle Troup, Anthony Simonsen, EJ Tackett, Cameron Crowe, and Jason Belmonte – as they chase glory, respect, and much-needed prize money on the Professional Bowlers Association (PBA) Tour. Set within bowling's blue‑collar culture, the series examines a familiar American family pastime that evokes myriad pop cultural references and reveals a quirky sport with ancient roots shaped as much by personality and persistence as by skill and precision. Every season, members of the PBA Tour travel from tournament to tournament with their balls in tow, fighting for victories from Akron to Reno, often needing to share budget hotel rooms along the way. At different stages of their careers, each man balances their ambition and love of the sport with the uncertainty of a profession built on week‑to‑week performance and earnings that often require them to take day jobs to make a living.
title: Born to Bowl

overview: Life is Strange follows Max, a photography student, who discovers she can rewind time while saving the life of her childhood best friend, Chloe. As she struggles to understand this new skill, the pair investigate the mysterious disappearance of a fellow student, uncovering a dark side to their town that will ultimately force them to make an impossible life or death choice that will impact them forever.
title: Life Is Strange

overview: With honesty and rigor, Rachel Maddow uniquely connects dots to advance stories on her show The Rachel Maddow Show. By exposing the layers of complex issues, she reveals their significance to viewers. In her irreverent style, Maddow transcends the narrative and provides unique perspective.
title: The Rachel Maddow Show

overview: A story of greed, lust and capriciousness, of people who don't consider the consequences of their actions until it's too late. Priao is young and spoiled with role-model parents. She's an unrepentant partier but she's faithful. Aon has grown up with the weight of her parent's hopes on her shoulders. They want to see her elevated in society with a wealthy, appropriate partner. One looks wicked, another looks put-together and sweet, just as she would have it.
title: Risk Lust Love
Ru Guo Qin Jian Hui Shuo Hua

overview: Treasure Island charts the transformation of teenager Jim Hawkins from sheltered boy to emboldened young pirate. When Jim gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess' clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger.
title: Treasure Island

overview: In Where There's Smoke, a group of firefighters will navigate the intense challenges of their profession while grappling with personal struggles, fractured relationships, and the emotional toll of saving lives in a world filled with danger, drama, and heartbreak.
title: Where There's Smoke
Leon – Glaub nicht alles, was du siehst

overview: Bigg Jah's dark comedy anthology explores the dangerous, absurd moments of Los Angeles hood life where survival often depends on bad decisions.
title: LAUGH
Yi Wan Quan Zhou Zhi Jiang Mu Ya

overview: The Factor, originally titled The O'Reilly Report from 1996 to 1998 and often called The O'Reilly Factor, is an American cable television news and talk show on the Fox News Channel hosted by political commentator Bill O'Reilly, who often discusses current controversial political issues with guests. The Factor is generally prerecorded, though on rare occasions it airs live if breaking news or special events are being covered (e.g. presidential addresses that occur during prime-time). It is usually taped between 5:00 and 7:00 PM Eastern Time and airs weekdays at 8:00 PM and 11:00 PM. The show is recorded "live to tape", meaning that the recording breaks for commercials as if the show was actually on the air while being recorded. Some guests are interviewed before the "live to tape" period and are slotted in the program as appropriate.
title: The Factor

overview: A small likay troupe is facing a major crisis. Following the sudden passing of the troupe's founder, his eldest son Petch-thae, unprepared, must step up as troupe leader and guide the family's likay troupe through all the troubles rushing in, all while endeavouring to preserve the vanishing traditional artform.
title: Bling Bling

overview: Boon is an elder craftsman of ghost masks, which are said to be vessels for the dead. After dreaming of his missing daughter, Lalita, calling for help in the forest, he's unaware when her spirit enters his latest piece. When travel content creator Thianphisut visits the Phi Ta Khon ghost festival in Loei with her boyfriend Rachen, she purchases Uncle Boon's blue mask and is possessed by Lalita's spirit. In this new form, Lalita meets her former lover Chatban, and he feels an uncanny familiarity.
title: The Mask of Love

overview: Tako has a son with Bell, and he's discovering he may be gay.
title: Saneha Stories 4: Saiyai Saneha

overview: Jenkhwan, an architecture freshman who loves competition, loses a bet with his good friend Pod. Consequently, Jenkhwan has to dress as a woman for their high school farewell party. By chance, Jenkhwan comes to save drunk comm arts freshy Pin. Jenkhwan likes her immediately but the two part ways before they can get to know one another. Fate, however, brings them together again under confusing circumstances: Jenkhwan's name ends up on the girls' dorm list and his roommate is none other than Pin. At first, Jenkhwan intends to clear things up and have his name moved to the men's dorm list. Then Pod proposes a new wager; as his rival, he thinks Jenkhwan has no chance of successfully hitting on Pin. As someone who never surrenders, Jenkhwan's next move is to become Jenny and take up his place in the women's dorm.
title: Jenny A.M./P.M.

overview: Retired Chicago Detective Pamela Childs revisits unsolved missing persons cases as she hopes to uncover new leads and find potential answers for the victims' families.
title: Hunt for the Missing: Chicago

overview: That Metal Show is a talk show hosted by Eddie Trunk with co-hosts Don Jamieson and Jim Florentine. It premiered on VH1 Classic on November 15, 2008. New episodes air on VH1 Classic on Saturday nights and are rebroadcast throughout the week.
title: That Metal Show

overview: Carl Williams' thirst for revenge ignites Australia's bloodiest underworld war. To dominate the drug trade, he enlists a team of misfits to eliminate all rivals. Enter, the hitmen.
title: Naked City: Hitmen

overview: Christophe Beaugrand is now part of the tour of the new series "Maison de Retraite". The actress Chantal Ladesou was part of the casting. Six episodes on each other in box and diffusion are scheduled to debut in 2026 on TF1.
title: Maison de retraite, la série

overview: The story revolves around 35-year-old gambler Daniyar. Having escaped the trap of gambling addiction and returned home from a rehabilitation center, he carries the heavy burden of the past: lost joy, inexhaustible debts, years that have wounded his soul. Now he is faced with the task of rekindling his son's faith, starting a new life, and finding himself again. On this journey, he meets a love that warms his heart and restores his faith in miracles. This series is a story about second chances and self-acceptance, reminding us that everyone deserves a new beginning.
title: NÜKTE

overview: The family and friends of Jonas Aarseth Henriksen are left in despair after the murder that shook Norway. New details and the full story provide more answers to what happened.
title: Drapet på LastebilJonas
